responsibility: This implementation module wraps the underlying cgetopt bindings to provide gm2 short- and long-option parsing. It converts DynamicStrings option specifications to C strings, reflects getopt global outputs such as optarg/opterr/optopt back into Modula-2 values, and manages a dynamically resized array of C long-option records using Storage and MemUtils so callers can construct the null-terminated option table required by getopt_long and getopt_long_only.
same_name_distinction: This file is the implementation of the GetOpt binding, defining the concrete long-option record storage, allocation/resizing logic, and calls into cgetopt that realize the abstract API declared in GetOpt.def.
